data.name: Ocr_EngineDesc
data.value: Official Windows.Media.Ocr WinRT API (Windows 10+). Desktop apps typically need MSIX package identity; install OCR language packs in Windows Settings.

data.name: Ocr_Language_Desc
data.value: Recognition language. Auto uses languages from the Windows user profile.

data.name: Ocr_Err_LanguageNotSupported
data.value: OCR language '{0}' is not installed or not supported. Install the OCR language pack in Windows Settings.

data.name: Ocr_Err_EngineCreateFailed
data.value: Failed to create Windows.Media.Ocr engine. Ensure OCR language packs are installed and the host has package identity (MSIX) if required.

data.name: Ocr_Err_NotAvailable
data.value: Windows.Media.Ocr is not available on this system (requires Windows 10 or later).
